action.en: Clip the nearby tall grass with the equipped tool.

success.en: The bag counter increases.

fallback.en: Approach a patch with empty bag space and check the tool is equipped.

action.en: Travel to the DROP-OFF marker when the bag fills.

success.en: The bag counter drops and cash increases.

fallback.en: Move closer to the marked selling point and recheck the counter.

action.en: Follow the next affordable purchase prompt to the shed.

success.en: The tool name or bag maximum changes.

fallback.en: Sell another load and compare the displayed price before buying.

action.en: Read the device controls on the current screen.

success.en: You can switch between viewing and interacting with menus.

fallback.en: Use the current device prompt when it differs from the PC recording.

action.en: Open TOOLS or BAGS in the shed.

success.en: The selected item name and price appear.

fallback.en: Use the tab and browsing arrows to locate the intended item.

action.en: Compare the next affordable tool with the equipped one.

success.en: A purchase changes the displayed equipment.

fallback.en: Keep cutting and selling until the displayed cost is covered.

action.en: Compare the next bag capacity with the current counter.

success.en: A purchase increases the bag maximum.

fallback.en: Check the selected bag and purchase state before leaving the shed.

action.en: Read the golden-grass message before estimating a sale.

success.en: You can distinguish a recorded value bonus from an ordinary clipping.

fallback.en: Leave unverified spawn rates and other multipliers out of the estimate.

action.en: Open UPGRADES and read its job-only warning.

success.en: The three upgrade cards show their current and next values.

fallback.en: Check the current panel before assuming a benefit is permanent.

action.en: Choose the card that addresses your current bottleneck.

success.en: The selected upgrade effect matches cutting, capacity or travel.

fallback.en: Compare a bag or tool purchase if it addresses the same problem.

action.en: Check the changed counter or card after buying.

success.en: The purchase advances a value or visibly changes the next trip.

fallback.en: Reopen the panel and inspect cash before another purchase.

action.en: Follow the phone objective and listen for ringing.

success.en: The objective supplies a search cue while you mow.

fallback.en: Keep clearing a connected area; a fixed spawn coordinate is unverified.

action.en: Check the objective after finding the phone.

success.en: It states that the phone is back and permits more mowing or heading home.

fallback.en: Keep using the current objective when that completion state has not appeared.

action.en: Inspect Phone Home after the completed trip.

success.en: The achievement shows its progress and current reward state.

fallback.en: Compare the claim state and gem counter before trying again.

action.en: Read Map 2 selection and requirements in the current game.

success.en: The destination names Grandpa’s keys as its objective.

fallback.en: Treat the route and access requirement as unverified until confirmed.
